description: The house arrowheads (ADR 0006, rule 9). One spec for the editor runtime, the static renderer and the picture checker: a head is a fixed size whatever the stroke, its tip sits exactly on the node's edge (refX is its length), and `shaft` is the straight wire kept under it, and the wire stops `tip_clear` px short of the tip (the marker's refX moves the same amount) so the stroke never pokes out of the point. `markup` is the marker's inner element with `{paint}` for the wire colour; `label` is what the inspector calls the head. Change a head here and every picture follows; nothing else knows a number.

open.label: Open
open.markup: <path d="M1,1 L6,3 L1,5" fill="none" stroke="{paint}" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

diamond.label: Diamond
diamond.markup: <path d="M0,3 L4,0 L8,3 L4,6 z" fill="{paint}"/>
